title: Mallworld Visitor Analytics Survey - Update and Results Release Date
content: Hi all! You may remember this post from a few months ago with an attached survey I have been conducting regarding people’s experiences with Mallworld dream phenomena. https://www.reddit.com/r/TheMallWorld/comments/152fwxb/mallworld_visitor_analytics_survey/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=ios_app&utm_name=ioscss&utm_content=2&utm_term=1 Many of you have eagerly been awaiting updates on the results of this survey, honestly far longer than I should have kept you waiting. I’ve been dealing with a lot of upheaval in my personal/professional life over the past several months so I haven’t had a chance to sit down and compile the results into a format readable by someone other than myself, though rest assured I have definitely been working through the info you’ve all given as well as a lot of other material with connections to further develop my theory on this topic, and I’ve finally reached a place both time-wise and info-wise that I’m just about ready to post the results. I wanted to post this update for two reasons; first is to announce that the final update will be posted next Sunday on November the 5th, and my hope is to conduct an AMA for the remainder of that day to further elaborate on and discuss the topic with all of you. The second reason is for anyone on the survey who answered the question “Would you be willing to answer any further questions on this topic?” or anyone else interested, and that is one last pair of questions I’d like to survey everyone on in the comments here, those being; -What is the earliest memory you have of this sort of dream? -What is the earliest memory you can recount in general? The regular survey is still open at this time, so if you haven’t taken it already I urge you to please do so prior to one week from today when I plan to close the survey, and if you know anyone else who has had this experience or are involved in any other online communities that discuss the Mallworld topic please feel free to share it for the last of its lifespan, and I look forward to getting more in-depth on this soon. Thank you all once again for your participation, and I hope the results I’ve found are of interest to you!
